app.name: SpesaSmart NL
app.tagline: Every supermarket offer in one place.
app.description: Compare supermarket offers in the Netherlands and find the cheapest route for your shopping list.

common.demoDataHint: Invented sample data, not real prices.
common.disclaimer: The final price and availability are confirmed by the store or the online service.

home.title: Your week
home.planEmptyTitle: No plan for this week yet
home.planEmptyBody: Put your groceries on the list and see where you pay the least.
home.searchLabel: Search a product, brand or EAN

offers.title: Offers
offers.emptyBody: Offers appear here as soon as they have been collected.

list.title: List
list.emptyBody: Add products from search or from the offers.

search.title: Search
search.emptyBody: Type a product, brand or EAN to compare prices.

more.title: More
more.installAndroid: Android: open the browser menu and choose 'Install app'.
more.installIos: iPhone or iPad: tap Share and choose 'Add to Home Screen'.
more.aboutBody: SpesaSmart NL is a personal project and is not affiliated with the supermarkets it names. Prices come from public offer pages and open data; every offer shows its source and when it was collected.
more.privacyBody: No account, no ads, no tracking. Your list belongs to this device.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Prices are not kept offline, so you never see an outdated price. Try again once you are back online.
